result.summary: The intersection is located beneath a large concrete overpass, creating a dark and potentially intimidating environment for pedestrians. While marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps are present, the roadway pavement is severely degraded and the scale of the infrastructure prioritizes heavy vehicle movement.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The asphalt in the intersection and across the crosswalk is severely cracked and degraded, creating tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Reduced Visibility Underpass
hazards.description: The large bridge structure creates shadows and a dark environment that can reduce the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and background under the bridge structure

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Blind Spots
hazards.description: The presence of heavy trucks at this wide intersection increases the risk of blind-spot related incidents during turns.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the roadway and crosswalk areas to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces.

interventions.title: Enhanced Underpass Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-output, pedestrian-scale lighting under the bridge to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps but is situated in a stark industrial environment with significantly degraded pavement. The lack of visible pedestrian signals and the wide, open nature of the roadway suggest a prioritized focus on vehicular movement over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt in the crosswalk and intersection is heavily cracked and uneven, creating significant tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at the intersection, leaving pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the entire intersection and crosswalk areas to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear timing information for people crossing the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps, but the infrastructure is poorly maintained. Faded paint and degraded pavement surfaces create potential hazards for pedestrians in an area with mixed residential and commercial land use.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra stripes are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked asphalt and uneven utility patches within the crosswalk area create trip hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked and patched pavement to provide a smooth, level walking surface for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals but is dominated by a large overpass and sound walls that create significant visual obstructions. The environment feels industrial and car-oriented, with limited visibility for pedestrians entering the underpass area.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Overpass
hazards.description: The concrete abutment of the overpass blocks sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross or entering the underpass.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the sidewalk enters the underpass.

hazards.name: Poor Lighting under Underpass
hazards.description: The area under the overpass appears dark, which can reduce pedestrian visibility and perceived safety.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side, under the bridge structure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to move pedestrians further into the line of sight of drivers before they cross and to shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Underpass Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-quality, pedestrian-scale lighting under the overpass to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.
